city.title: Select City
city.description: Choose the city where you want to monitor a YouBike station.

search.title: Search Stations
search.description: Enter a keyword to filter stations by name.

results.title: Select Station
results.description: Found {count} stations matching "{keyword}". Select the station you want to monitor.

settings.title: Update Settings
settings.description: Set how often to poll for new data.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to fetch station list. Check your network connection.
error.no_station_selected: Please select a station, or check "Search again" to go back.

init.title: Update Settings
init.description: Set how often to poll for new data.

station_ids.name: Station IDs
station_ids.description: Station UIDs to refresh (e.g. KHH501208057). Leave empty to refresh all stations.

polling_failing.title: YouBike API unreachable
polling_failing.description: Sustained polling failures for station {station_id}. The official YouBike website API is unofficial and known to hiccup; check Home Assistant connectivity and review the integration log for details. The notification clears automatically once polling succeeds again.
